releases.displayName: The new update brings numerous improvements:

items.text: Significantly optimized controls in the classic version
New pause function during gameplay
Improved hit detection for UFOs and falling objects
Revamped visual effects for asteroids and meteors
Improvements to controller support
Further gameplay optimizations and stability improvements
Other fixes

Noah Ezrin, a die hard Intellivision fan from Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia was working closely with the developers and is delighted about the new versions: “The reboot of Astrosmash was easily one of my most anticipated titles anyway. It’s been an absolute blast playtesting various console builds of Astrosmash across Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. Many improvements have been implemented in the latest updates, which make these reimagined Intellivision classics the definitive way to experience these legendary games on modern platforms. The Classic Astrosmash now features significantly improved controls, along with the ability to pause the game mid-session. In the latest reimagined version of Astrosmash, players will notice improved hit detection for flying and falling objects such as UFOs, as well as more detailed asteroids and meteors as they crash toward the ground.”

Welcome to our new Astrosmash version.

Many of you have asked for the original Astrosmash version from 1981. We have fulfilled your wishes. This new update makes it possible to play the old original version from 1981 as well as the modern new Astrosmash version. We hope you enjoy this trip into the past of the video game world of 1981!
General stability fixes
Gameplay improvements
Steamdeck support improvements
New localization languages support
